name: Excess tail fade to POC
note: Builds a 30-minute TPO profile of each completed RTH session on rows of row_atr * daily ATR and looks for EXCESS: at least min_rows consecutive single-print rows at a session extreme, spanning at least tail_frac of the session range. That is the auction-theory signature of a finished auction, as opposed to a poor high which asks to be revisited. The tail base and the same session's point of control are registered for depth sessions; when price later trades back beyond the base and a bar CLOSES back inside it, the original rejection has re-confirmed and the trade is taken against the tail, targeting that session's POC with the stop at the excess extreme plus stop_buf daily ATRs, abandoned at flat_min ET of the hold_sessions-th session after entry. A record is erased when a session closes beyond the excess extreme, and fires at most once - without that a single tail re-arms all day and the family degenerates into fading one session's high repeatedly. Execution is one native bar rather than the idea's 15 minutes, since the trigger is bar-size agnostic and the family is handed whatever the study is running.
source: Dalton, Jones & Dalton, 'Mind Over Markets'; excess/tail definitions per the 'Excess + Tails in TPO profile' tear sheet (webflow-hosted, 2020) and the ShadowTrader glossary entries for excess high/excess low ('the minimum number of TPOs necessary to define an excess low is two').

import datetime

_DST = {}


def _dst_span(y):
    """US Eastern DST window in UTC: 2nd Sunday of March 07:00Z to 1st Sunday
    of November 06:00Z. Computed arithmetically so the family needs no tz
    database (Windows pythons often ship without one)."""
    b = _DST.get(y)
    if b is None:
        d = datetime.date(y, 3, 8)
        d += datetime.timedelta(days=(6 - d.weekday()) % 7)
        s = datetime.datetime(y, 3, d.day, 7)
        e0 = datetime.date(y, 11, 1)
        e0 += datetime.timedelta(days=(6 - e0.weekday()) % 7)
        e = datetime.datetime(y, 11, e0.day, 6)
        b = _DST[y] = (s, e)
    return b


def _et(stamp):
    """(ET ordinal day, ET minute of day) from a UTC ISO bar stamp."""
    s = str(stamp)
    dt = datetime.datetime(int(s[0:4]), int(s[5:7]), int(s[8:10]),
                           int(s[11:13]), int(s[14:16]))
    a, b = _dst_span(dt.year)
    loc = dt + datetime.timedelta(hours=(-4 if a <= dt < b else -5))
    return loc.toordinal(), loc.hour * 60 + loc.minute


def family_init(ctx):
    """Auction-theory excess: a tail of price rows that only ONE 30-minute
    period ever touched is aggressive opposing size rejecting the level
    instantly, and it says the auction up there is finished. Register the
    tail's base and the same session's point of control; when a later session
    pushes back through the base and a bar closes back inside, that is the
    original rejection re-confirming, and the objective is the price that
    session itself agreed was fair.

    Profile rows are row_atr * daily ATR wide, periods are 30 minutes of RTH,
    and the daily ATR is built from COMPLETED prior sessions only. A record is
    erased when a session closes beyond the excess extreme - at that point the
    auction up there was not finished after all - and expires after
    depth sessions.

    Execution here is one native bar rather than the idea's 15 minutes: the
    family is handed whatever bar size the study is running, and the trigger
    (trade beyond the base, close back inside) is bar-size agnostic. A record
    fires at most once; without that a single tail would re-arm all day and
    the family would be measuring one session's high over and over.
    """
    bars = ctx.bars
    n = len(bars)
    op = [float(b["o"]) for b in bars]
    hi = [float(b["h"]) for b in bars]
    lo = [float(b["l"]) for b in bars]
    cl = [float(b["c"]) for b in bars]

    rowk = float(ctx.p.row_atr)
    minr = max(1, int(ctx.p.min_rows))
    tfrac = float(ctx.p.tail_frac)
    depth = max(1, int(ctx.p.depth))
    buf = float(ctx.p.stop_buf)
    ndays = max(2, int(ctx.p.atr_days))
    per_min = max(5, int(ctx.p.period_min))

    day = [0] * n
    tod = [0] * n
    for i in range(n):
        day[i], tod[i] = _et(bars[i]["t"])

    RTH0, RTH1 = 570, 960                       # 09:30 and 16:00 ET
    order = []
    idx = {}
    for i in range(n):
        if not (RTH0 <= tod[i] < RTH1):
            continue
        d = day[i]
        if d not in idx:
            idx[d] = []
            order.append(d)
        idx[d].append(i)

    sess = {d: k for k, d in enumerate(order)}
    si = [None] * n
    for i in range(n):
        si[i] = sess.get(day[i])

    # daily true range and an ATR over completed prior sessions only
    trs = []
    prev_c = None
    atrd = {}
    for d in order:
        ii = idx[d]
        dh = max(hi[j] for j in ii)
        dl = min(lo[j] for j in ii)
        tr = dh - dl if prev_c is None else max(dh - dl, abs(dh - prev_c),
                                                abs(dl - prev_c))
        if len(trs) >= 3:
            wnd = trs[-ndays:]
            atrd[d] = sum(wnd) / len(wnd)
        trs.append(tr)
        prev_c = cl[ii[-1]]

    # ---- build one session's TPO profile and read its excess tails ----
    recs = {}                                   # session k -> list of records
    for k, d in enumerate(order):
        a = atrd.get(d)
        if a is None or a <= 0:
            continue
        w = rowk * a
        if w <= 0:
            continue
        ii = idx[d]
        per = {}
        for j in ii:
            g = (tod[j] - RTH0) // per_min
            q = per.get(g)
            if q is None:
                per[g] = [hi[j], lo[j]]
            else:
                if hi[j] > q[0]:
                    q[0] = hi[j]
                if lo[j] < q[1]:
                    q[1] = lo[j]
        if len(per) < 4:
            continue
        tpo = {}
        for g in per:
            q = per[g]
            r0 = int(q[1] // w)
            r1 = int(q[0] // w)
            if r1 - r0 > 4000:
                r1 = r0 + 4000
            for r in range(r0, r1 + 1):
                tpo[r] = tpo.get(r, 0) + 1
        if not tpo:
            continue
        rows = sorted(tpo)
        rlo, rhi = rows[0], rows[-1]
        srng = max(q[0] for q in per.values()) - min(q[1] for q in per.values())
        if srng <= 0:
            continue
        mid = (max(q[0] for q in per.values()) + min(q[1] for q in per.values())) / 2.0
        best = max(tpo.values())
        poc_row = min((r for r, c in tpo.items() if c == best),
                      key=lambda r: abs((r + 0.5) * w - mid))
        poc = (poc_row + 0.5) * w
        out = []

        # excess HIGH: consecutive single-print rows counted down from the top
        cnt = 0
        r = rhi
        while r >= rlo and tpo.get(r, 0) == 1:
            cnt += 1
            r -= 1
        if cnt >= minr and cnt * w >= tfrac * srng and (rhi - cnt) > poc_row:
            out.append({"d": -1, "tb": (rhi - cnt + 1) * w,
                        "ext": max(q[0] for q in per.values()),
                        "poc": poc, "k": k, "armed": False})

        # excess LOW: the mirror, counted up from the bottom
        cnt = 0
        r = rlo
        while r <= rhi and tpo.get(r, 0) == 1:
            cnt += 1
            r += 1
        if cnt >= minr and cnt * w >= tfrac * srng and (rlo + cnt) < poc_row:
            out.append({"d": 1, "tb": (rlo + cnt) * w,
                        "ext": min(q[1] for q in per.values()),
                        "poc": poc, "k": k, "armed": False})
        if out:
            recs[k] = out

    # ---- walk forward, arm and fire ----
    sig = [0.0] * n
    tgt = [None] * n
    stp = [None] * n
    dln = [None] * n
    active = []
    cur = -1
    for i in range(n):
        s = si[i]
        if s is None:                            # outside RTH: no trigger
            continue
        a = atrd.get(day[i])
        if s != cur:                             # a session has just started
            cur = s
            keep = []
            pc = None
            if s > 0:
                pj = idx[order[s - 1]][-1]
                pc = cl[pj]
            for rc in active:
                if s - rc["k"] > depth:
                    continue                     # expired
                if pc is not None:
                    if rc["d"] < 0 and pc > rc["ext"]:
                        continue                 # closed beyond: not excess
                    if rc["d"] > 0 and pc < rc["ext"]:
                        continue
                keep.append(rc)
            active = keep
            for rc in recs.get(s - 1, []):       # the session that just ended
                active.append(rc)
        if a is None or a <= 0 or not active:
            continue
        fired = None
        for rc in active:
            if rc["d"] < 0:                      # excess high -> fade shorts
                if hi[i] > rc["tb"]:
                    rc["armed"] = True
                if rc["armed"] and cl[i] < rc["tb"] and cl[i] > rc["poc"]:
                    fired = rc
                    break
            else:                                # excess low -> fade longs
                if lo[i] < rc["tb"]:
                    rc["armed"] = True
                if rc["armed"] and cl[i] > rc["tb"] and cl[i] < rc["poc"]:
                    fired = rc
                    break
        if fired is None:
            continue
        active.remove(fired)
        d = fired["d"]
        sig[i] = float(d)
        t = fired["poc"]
        st = fired["ext"] + buf * a * (1.0 if d < 0 else -1.0)
        dead = s + int(ctx.p.hold_sessions)
        j = i
        while j < n and (si[j] is None or si[j] <= dead):
            tgt[j] = t
            stp[j] = st
            dln[j] = float(dead)
            j += 1

    ctx.sig = ctx.series(sig, "excess_signal")
    ctx.tgt = ctx.series(tgt, "poc_target")
    ctx.stp = ctx.series(stp, "excess_stop")
    ctx.dln = ctx.series(dln, "deadline")
    ctx.si = ctx.series([None if x is None else float(x) for x in si], "session")
    ctx.tod = ctx.series([float(x) for x in tod], "et_minute")
    ctx._flat = float(ctx.p.flat_min)


def signal(ctx, i):
    s = ctx.sig[i]
    if not s:
        return 0
    return 1 if s > 0 else -1


def exit_signal(ctx, i):
    """Target is the origin session's POC, stop is its excess extreme plus a
    buffer, and the trade is abandoned at flat_min ET of the hold_sessions-th
    session after entry if the POC never came."""
    if not ctx.positions:
        return False
    p = ctx.positions[0]
    e = p["entry_i"]
    t = ctx.tgt[e]
    st = ctx.stp[e]
    dl = ctx.dln[e]
    if t is None or st is None or dl is None:
        return True
    s = ctx.si[i]
    if s is not None:
        if s > dl:
            return True
        if s >= dl and ctx.tod[i] >= ctx._flat:
            return True
    px = ctx.c[i]
    if p["side"] == "long":
        return px >= t or px <= st
    return px <= t or px >= st
